```{r message=FALSE}
#install.packages("mobsim")
#install.packages("iNEXT")
library(mobsim)
library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)
library(iNEXT)
```

## Simulate an even and an uneven community with random spatial positions

```{r}
# Even community
set.seed(42)
com1 <- sim_poisson_community(s_pool = 30, n_sim = 500, sad_type = "lnorm",
                              sad_coef = list("sdlog" = 0))
plot(com1)

# Uneven community
com2 <- sim_poisson_community(s_pool = 30, n_sim = 500, sad_type = "lnorm",
                             sad_coef = list("sdlog" = 1))

plot(com2)
```


```{r}
# Real diversity 

# Community 1

count1 <- com1$census %>% 
  group_by(species) %>% 
  summarize(count = as.numeric(length(species))) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "species")

count.t <- t(count1)

# Diversity
exp(diversity(count.t, "shannon"))
(diversity(count.t, "invsimpson"))

# Community 2

count2 <- com2$census %>% 
  group_by(species) %>% 
  summarize(count = as.numeric(length(species))) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "species")

count2.t <- t(count2)

# Diversity
exp(diversity(count2.t, "shannon"))
(diversity(count2.t, "invsimpson"))

```

## Take samples from source communities spatially-explicit census

```{r}
comm_mat1    <- sample_quadrats(com1, n_quadrats = 4,
quadrat_area = 0.08, method = "random", avoid_overlap = T) 

comm_mat2    <- sample_quadrats(com2, n_quadrats = 4,
quadrat_area = 0.08, method = "random", avoid_overlap = T) 
```

## Graphical exploration

```{r, warning = FALSE}
data1       <- t(comm_mat1$spec_dat)
data1.clean <- data1[, colSums(data1 != 0) > 0]
out1        <- iNEXT(data1.clean, q=c(0, 1, 2), datatype="abundance", endpoint = 100, nboot = 50)

data2       <- t(comm_mat2$spec_dat)
data2.clean <- data2[, colSums(data2 != 0) > 0]
out2        <- iNEXT(data2.clean, q=c(0, 1, 2), datatype="abundance", endpoint = 100, nboot = 50)

```

### Hill diversity

```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5}
ggiNEXT(out1, type=1, color.var="Order.q", facet.var="Assemblage")
ggiNEXT(out2, type=1, color.var="Order.q", facet.var="Assemblage")
```

### Number of individuals vs. coverage

```{r,fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5}
ggiNEXT(out1, type = 2, color.var="Order.q", facet.var="Assemblage")
ggiNEXT(out2, type = 2, color.var="Order.q", facet.var="Assemblage")
```

### Standardization by coverage

```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5}
ggiNEXT(out1, type = 3, color.var="Order.q", facet.var="Assemblage")
ggiNEXT(out2, type = 3, color.var="Order.q", facet.var="Assemblage")
```

```{r}
count2
```

## Beta diversity 

```{r}
combined_data <- comm_mat1$spec_dat %>%
  bind_rows(comm_mat2$spec_dat) %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0)

com.structure   <- metaMDS(combined_data[,1:30], distance = "bray")
spp.scores      <- as.data.frame(scores(com.structure)$sites)

spp.scores.data <- spp.scores %>%
  mutate(community = rep(c("community1", "community2"), each = 4)) %>%
  mutate(sites = rep(c("site1", "site2", "site3", "site4"), times = 2))

ggplot(spp.scores.data, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, shape = community, color = sites))+
  geom_point(size = 6)+
  theme_bw()



```
